coverage_claim: The adjudicated structure covers, for a single directed duty used as a mixin: deontic core and violability, obligor/obligee/beneficiary/enforcement roles, obligated action and subject matter, antecedent conditions and ODRL-form constraint expression, due time, recurrence, limitation and survival, an explicit lifecycle state model with dual timestamps, fulfilment with acceptance and evidence, non-performance with excuse, cure and remedy, legal basis, authority and jurisdiction, stewardship, provenance, confidentiality and retention, composition, transfer, plurality, and standards alignment — plus the imported XACML/HL7 obligation-sense crosswalk and the UNIDROIT cure/additional-period operation. Grounding is limited to the cited primary standards; service-level-objective structure and obligations-register operations remain declared gaps. No claim of jurisdictional, deontic-logical or universal completeness is made.

boundary_decision.rationale: Both providers independently arrived at mixin, and the base scope statement, ten boundary notes and explicit out-of-scope list draw complete lines against the agreement instrument, party master data, the policy/rule container, task execution, payment and settlement mechanics, dispute management, control registers and accounting recognition. The base also passes the definitional/alethic filter (SBVR) that keeps non-violable necessities out of the register. The only boundary pressure in this adjudication is the imported access-control and conformance obligation sense, which is admitted as a crosswalk alignment entry only, leaving the base exclusion of decision-point and evaluation infrastructure intact.

add_findings.rationale: The base crosswalk (standard-alignment) enumerates ODRL Duty, LegalRuleML Obligation, FIBO commitment, IFRS 15 performance obligation and compliance registers but omits XACML 3.0 PEP Obligation and HL7/FHIR Obligation codes, both tier-1 primary sources (SRC-006, SRC-007) in the source provider. These are homonyms of 'obligation' denoting a mandated PEP operation and a SHALL/SHOULD/MAY conformance behaviour, and merging them with contractual or legal duties on the English label is a concrete conflation hazard the base does not test for. Import only the sense-disambiguation and alignment-map content as a sibling finding in this layer: the access and retention questions carried by the source finding are already covered by base access-and-retention and must not be duplicated, and no PEP evaluation infrastructure is admitted to scope.

add_functions.rationale: The base function set moves from declare-non-performance directly to apply-remedy, leaving no operation for UNIDROIT 7.1.4 cure by the non-performing party or 7.1.5 grant of an additional period, which suspend inconsistent remedies and can still discharge the original duty. The base already recognises the concept as a question (q-cure-period in excuse-remedy-consequence) but cannot operate it; the source function is grounded in a tier-1 primary source (SRC-004) and does not duplicate any existing base function.

decisions.rationale: The base carries ten boundary notes, an explicit out-of-scope list and adversarial counterexamples (commitment at large, negative duty, asset-free statutory duty, maintenance duty, owed-but-time-barred duty) that close the model edges. The alternative's seven notes are sound but leave party roles, stewardship, provenance and retention thin. Node count was not decisive; edge completeness was.

Both providers independently classified the entry as a mixin attachable to contracts, statutes, licences, orders, policies and unilateral commitments, and neither structure carries instrument formation, party identity or ledger semantics that would force a standalone entity.

Tier-1 primary grounding for two obligation homonyms absent from the base crosswalk; admitted as mapping and sense-disambiguation only, with the source finding's access and retention material dropped as duplicative of base access-and-retention.

decisions.concept: IAS 37 provision recognition and measurement overlay
decisions.rationale: The base explicitly out-of-scopes accounting recognition and measurement and draws a boundary note to Liability/Provision. Importing provision amount, risk adjustment, discounting and onerous-contract testing would reopen a deliberately closed edge and duplicate a sibling financial-reporting model.

decisions.concept: IAS 37 legal versus constructive obligation classification
decisions.rationale: Adjacent to but not identical with the base external-versus-voluntary origin axis from ISO 37301. Deciding whether constructive obligation is an origin class of the duty or only a recognition trigger requires primary clause text neither provider read, so it is not bolted onto obligation-typology on inference.

Tier-3 non-primary profile, and the source provider itself flags adopting it as canonical as an over-claim. The base lifecycle-state-machine is grounded in the ODRL fulfilment test, LegalRuleML Violation/Compliance indications and the achievement/maintenance distinction, which is stronger support.

Place and currency of performance already sit in base subject-and-place, and ordering with reciprocal dependency in finding-composition-and-dependency; importing the finding would fragment place of performance across two nodes. Its one unique element, withholding performance, is deferred to research instead.

Base antecedent-and-detachment plus constraint-expression already carry suspensive and resolutive conditions, detachment evidence and timestamping, improper interference, and the full ODRL Constraint and LogicalConstraint expression form including andSequence ordering.

Base excuse-remedy-consequence already carries the ODRL consequence and remedy nesting prohibitions, LegalRuleML PenaltyStatement and Reparation, cure periods, penalty caps, and the recursion of secondary duties back onto this model as obligations in their own right.

The base already asserts ODRL Validator and Evaluator grounding in its validation checklist dimension and covers competent issuer and evidence sufficiency in fulfilment-evidence; importing the combined evidence finding would create a second evidence node for one extra distinction.

The base recognises cure as a question but exposes no operation between declaring non-performance and applying remedy, so the suspension of inconsistent remedies during an additional period is currently unreachable; grounded in a tier-1 primary source.

Enforcing ObligationExpressions on a Permit or Deny decision is decision-point infrastructure, which the base out-of-scopes. The XACML sense enters as a crosswalk entry only, never as an operation of this mixin.

Follows the same boundary as the rejected IAS 37 overlay: applying provision versus contingent-liability tests is a financial-reporting operation on some obligations, not an operation of the deontic record itself.

Base transition-state applies permitted transitions with authority, basis, event time and observation time, and fulfilment-and-acceptance already enumerates discharge modes including substitute performance, set-off, waiver, release and expiry.

decisions.disposition: recorded as declared divergence, not resolved
decisions.rationale: Both providers independently find that LegalRuleML obligation-of-a-negated-act and the ODRL disjoint Prohibition subclass will not round-trip. The base already records violation polarity and a divergence list, so synthesis keeps this as a crosswalk conflict rather than choosing a winner without primary authority to do so.

The two providers scatter access, retention, validation and interoperability service concerns across different bundles; merging them onto the base's single service surface prevents two competing access-control and retention narratives coexisting in one published model.

publication_holds: Live-URL and version-pin verification for all fourteen base sources plus the two imported ones (XACML 3.0, HL7 FHIR obligation codes) before any citation is published.

FIBO source conflict: the base pins spec.edmcouncil.org Agreements and Contracts at 'master/latest retrieved 2026-08-23' while the other provider pins raw.githubusercontent.com at versionIRI 20260601. Resolve to one dated release IRI before publication.

UNIDROIT edition pin: the base cites the 2016 black-letter PDF, while the imported cure and additional-period function derives from a 2010 Chapter 7 Section 1 page. Confirm 2016 numbering for Articles 7.1.1 to 7.1.5 before citing them.

Multi-profile domain validation: exercise the mixin against a contract clause, a statutory or regulatory duty, a court or administrative order, an internal voluntary commitment and an access-control or conformance obligation before claiming the alignment holds.

Performance-standard finding remains partially supported: ISO/IEC 19086-1 returned HTTP 403, so thresholds, metrics and measurement windows must be published as generic structure explicitly labelled as lacking primary grounding.

ISO 37301 normative clause text is paywalled and only the committee scope statement was read; register upkeep, review cadence and escalation must be published as practice, not as cited normative requirements.

Confirm the imported XACML and FHIR sense alignment is published as a crosswalk entry only and does not reopen the base exclusion of access-control decision points and their evaluation infrastructure.
No conformance claim to ODRL, LegalRuleML, FIBO, IFRS 15, XACML or FHIR may be published without a dated validation report; alignment relations only until then.
deferred_research: UNIDROIT 7.1.2: non-performance caused by the other party's act or by a risk it bears, and whether the base needs an explicit interference and risk-allocation defence distinct from the existing condition-interference question.

UNIDROIT 7.1.3 withholding of performance in reciprocal obligations (simultaneous versus consecutive tender) as a distinct pre-remedy state of an unperformed duty, currently absent from both the composition and the non-performance layers.

UNIDROIT 7.2.1 and 7.2.2 limits on specific performance (impossibility, unreasonable burden, reasonable cover from another source, exclusively personal character) and whether they belong to this mixin or to a remedies sibling model.
Whether the IAS 37 constructive obligation and the ISO 37301 voluntary commitment are the same origin axis; requires the normative clause text of both, neither of which was read by either provider.

Multiagent commitment operations (create, cancel, release, delegate, assign) over C(debtor, creditor, antecedent, consequent): the AAMAS commitment-alignment PDF failed to parse, so the finer-grained operations remain unasserted in the state model.

Insolvency effects on enforceability — automatic stay, set-off on insolvency, subordination and rescission of preferences — listed as a base known omission and material to the limitation and survival findings.
DPROD Duty profile status and whether any Dimension declares it, before its Pending/Active/Fulfilled/Violated vocabulary could ever be referenced as more than a third-party profile.
